sentences.text:
The present petition has been filed seeking quashing of Fir No.704/2014 under Sections
498A/406/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (Ipc) registered at Police Station Khajuri Khas.

2.  Counsel for the petitioners submits that the matter has been settled between the petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2, being his former wife, vide Settlement Deed dated 8th November, 2017, which has been filed as Annexure P-1.
Further, divorce by mutual consent has also been granted vide decree of divorce dated 18th December, 2017.
4. Notice is accepted by the learned ASC appearing for the State.
This is a digitally signed order.
